scope: Explains every non-passing case of the Profiles 4.1 variation replay (default server configuration) by its first blocker. Families never change a status and grant no conformance credit. Workstreams: implementation (missing behavior), policy (a deliberate server configuration or harness non-perturbation rule), interpretation (open TC question, docs/interpretations.md), corpus (proven sample defect with a labelled corrected fixture).

families.detail: 3DES key (generation|import) is disabled by server policy
families.note: 3DES is off by default (--triple-des, docs/algorithms.md#3des). The Symmetric Key Foundry profile needs `enabled`; the 3DES-enabled replay is reported separately. CS-BC-M-4-12-3DES-13 also uses a single-DES-equivalent key that every policy refuses (docs/interpretations.md#a-single-des-equivalent-3des-test-key).

Draft 3.0 Device, One-Time Password and Hashed Password Credential objects are not implemented as System Objects yet.

FIPS mode (KMIP_FIPS=true, docs/fips.md) refuses a non-approved mechanism with the reason its operation gives an unsupported one and a Result Message naming FIPS mode: ChaCha20, DSA, non-NIST curves, SHA-1 or short-key signature generation, RSASSA-PSS salts longer than the hash (the 1.3/1.4+ default salts), client-chosen AES-GCM encryption IVs, and the HASH/HMAC/ENCRYPT/SP 800-108/AWS derivation methods. Used only for the FIPS-mode variation report.
